text:
incident-bot: P1 alert — runtime-service (prod-west-1) error spike. 5xxs up 3x over last 5m. Logs show repeated 'CUDA illegal memory access' and 'misaligned address' coming from gpu-runtime v2.7.3 on multiple pods. Paging: paging@oncall triggered.

maya: taking lead — oncall-ml here. investigating. which node groups are affected?

tess: seeing container restarts + node flaps in gpu-pool-3 and gpu-pool-7. kubelet reports OOM kills + GPU page faults. one node flapped fully (reboot) at 1945678928.

sam: reproducing tail of dmesg from node gpu-07: 
```
[ 1234.567890] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, pid=20389, GPU at 0x7ff... Illegal memory access at 0x0000000040
[ 1234.567891] gpu_runtime: misaligned address in kernel memcpy, pc=0x7ff...
[ 1234.567892] containerd: task: runtime service exited with status 139
```

sam: also seeing this in runtime logs: `kv-cache` refcount changes right before crash. suspect recent kernel/path optimization in v2.7.3.

maya: good catch. we rolled v2.7.3 to canary 2h ago (deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-15T08:20Z).

tess: impact: ~12% of requests to runtime-service failing with immediate 5xx, another ~18% degraded latency due to retries/fallback to CPU pool. customers using low-latency endpoints for chat are impacted. no data exfiltration observed.

maya: immediate mitigation plan: 1) divert traffic away from gpu-pool-3/7 to GPU spare pool and CPU fallback for heavy requests, 2) patch runtime config to disable `kv-cache-addr-optim`, 3) restart runtime pods gradually, 4) if instability continues, roll back to v2.7.2.

sam: commands to shift routing (run on control-plane):
```bash
# mark nodes unschedulable in affected pools
kubectl cordon node/gpu-07 node/gpu-23 -n runtime
# update runtime routing configmap to prefer gpu-spare-pool
kubectl -n runtime set data routing-config preferPool=gpu-spare-pool --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
# rollout restart runtime daemonset
kubectl -n runtime rollout restart ds/runtime-gpu
```

maya: I'm going to apply a hot-config first (disable kv-cache flag) to minimize blast radius. applying now.

deploy-bot: configmap runtime-config updated: `KV_CACHE_ADDR_OPTIM=false` (applied by maya).

maya: rolling restarts on canary pods first (3 pods) — monitoring metrics.

tess: note: draining node will evict long-context sessions. set TTL to 30s for reroute to avoid stuck sessions.

sam: making progress: after disabling `KV_CACHE_ADDR_OPTIM` the GPU page fault rate dropped from 18/min to ~2/min on canary. some nodes still showing residual OOMs (old crash loops).

maya: good. next step: schedule rolling rollback if numbers trend back up. also notify SRE to drain and reboot the three fully flapped nodes.

arjun: joining now — oncall-sre taking handoff at 1945679000. pls summarize state for me.

maya: summary for handoff -> active mitigation: config flag disabled, canary restarts completed, error rate cut by ~80% on canary. still ~6 nodes with crash loops requiring manual reboot/drain. customer impact: degraded latency and ~8% request failures cluster-wide. actions pending: drain/reboot nodes, monitor 30m, prepare rollback to v2.7.2 if regressions.

arjun: acknowledged. I'll coordinate node reboots and coordinate a staged rollback if needed. who owns post-incident ticket?

tess: i'll open INC-2026-042 and assign postmortem to eng-runtime, SRE, and QA. add changelog for v2.7.3.

deploy-bot: canary -> stable promotion paused for runtime v2.7.3.

maya: tagging customers affected and sending incident notification draft — cc @support.

sam: quick note: logs show a race in kernel memcpy path when `kv-cache` moves pointers between threads. add to investigation list: reproduce with ASAN/TSAN on a smaller dev rig, audit refcount paths.

arjun: oncall-sre will run `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` on the 3 bad nodes in next 10m windows to avoid cascade. monitoring hooked to incident dashboard.

maya: handing off: i'm OOTO in ~40m, but will stay reachable by DM. arjun, tess — please take lead.

tess: roger. keep this pinned. will update every 10m or on status change. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: paging reminder sent to escalation group at 1945679015.

deploy-bot: rollback job prepared (v2.7.2) but not executed. use `deploy rollback runtime v2.7.2 --approve` to trigger.

arjun: thanks — starting node reboots now. will update when nodes healthy.

tess: documenting customer impact in INC-2026-042 and adding action items: reproduce, kernel patch, runtime hotfix, postmortem + customer comms.

maya: closing my loop — good work team.

arjun: (later) nodes rebooted, pods stabilized. error rates back to baseline. leaving this thread open for postmortem notes.

deploy-bot: incident timeline recorded to INC-2026-042.

tess: assigning action owners: sam (repro + kernel investigation), maya (postmortem writeup), arjun (node maintenance runbook update).

maya: thanks — will draft postmortem and link logs. :heart:

sam: adding initial repro logs to INC ticket.

arjun: handoff complete.
